title: An old prohibition gains precise meaning

captions.physics: Discovering a conversational ban’s mistaken basis
captions.energy: Responding to a newly heard meaning
captions.emotions: Feeling uncertainty about a possible continuation

meaning: You can discover a conversational ban’s mistaken basis and respond to a newly heard meaning, acknowledging uncertainty about how the conversation might continue.
text: The Tower in the physical position of your Vishuddha reveals a mistaken basis for prohibiting a conversation. Judgement in energy supports willingness to respond to meaning heard anew and allow an important question to sound different. The Moon in emotions brings uncertainty about a possible continuation. A new understanding of earlier words does not automatically reveal each person’s present wish. You can hear an old limit more precisely while still not knowing how returning to the subject will feel.

For example, “We do not discuss that any more” proves to be a memory of a request not to discuss the question in front of guests. Clarification removes the earlier unconditional prohibition’s basis. **A limit heard anew leaves room for a genuine answer**. You can name the difference and ask about readiness to talk now. This possibility may bring interest as well as wariness. Neither response alone proves that the subject is wanted or forbidden; the present answer still needs to be heard.

Difficulty arises if accuracy about the old words becomes a right to continue immediately without asking about today’s readiness. Uncertainty about feelings is filled by a confident decision for both. Constructive Judgement helps respond genuinely to the new meaning, including a still unclear response to the topic. You can recognise that the earlier prohibition was narrower than remembered and leave present choice open; clarifying the past does not replace today’s agreement to talk.
